scripts.dev: npm run build -w @qevra/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @qevra/contracts" "npm run dev -w @qevra/api" "npm run dev -w @qevra/web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @qevra/contracts && npm run dev -w @qevra/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @qevra/contracts && npm run dev -w @qevra/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @qevra/contracts && npm run build -w @qevra/api && npm run build -w @qevra/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @qevra/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.verify:browser: npm run build -w @qevra/contracts && npm run build -w @qevra/api && node scripts/verify-browser.mjs
scripts.verify:phase2: npm run build -w @qevra/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/verify-phase2-browser.mjs
scripts.seed:queue: npm run build -w @qevra/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/seed-queue.mjs
scripts.verify:phase3: npm run build -w @qevra/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/verify-phase3-browser.mjs
scripts.verify:phase4: npm run build -w @qevra/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/verify-phase4-browser.mjs
scripts.verify:phase5: npm run build -w @qevra/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/verify-phase5-browser.mjs
scripts.verify:phase6: npm run build -w @qevra/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/verify-phase6-browser.mjs
scripts.verify:phase7: npm run build -w @qevra/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/verify-phase7-browser.mjs
scripts.verify:phase8: npm run build -w @qevra/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/verify-phase8-browser.mjs
